configurationFields.label: Please Note
configurationFields.description: Valheim does not support Steam Workshop. Any items or collections entered here will not be loaded by the server. Valheim mods must be installed using BepInEx / Valheim Plus (configured under Runtime Configuration or manually via Thunderstore/Nexus/Hexium).

configurationFields.label: Install BepInEx
configurationFields.description: If set, BepInEx will be installed when the server is updated. Configure "BepInEx Version" accordingly. Standalone - DO NOT use with the Install Valheim Plus option. NOTE: Update the server after enabling this option.

configurationFields.label: BepInEx Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [BepInEx version](https://thunderstore.io/c/valheim/p/denikson/BepInExPack_Valheim/versions/) to install. Empty = latest. NOTE: Update the server after switching versions!

configurationFields.label: Install Valheim Plus
configurationFields.description: Installs [Valheim Plus](https://github.com/Grantapher/ValheimPlus). Includes BepInEx. NOTE: Update the server after enabling this option.

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Server name as it appears in the server list

configurationFields.label: Weltname
configurationFields.description: Name of the world .db file to load. Also used as the random seed used for terrain random generation

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Password that clients must supply in order to connect. NOTE: Unless a mod is used to remove the need for a password, the server requires a password that is at least 5 characters long and that is not included in the server name. Default: 12345.

configurationFields.label: Server is Public
configurationFields.description: Whether the server is listed in the public in-game community server browser (-public). If disabled, the server is unlisted/private, but players can still connect directly using the server IP:Port or Join Code.

configurationFields.label: Enable Crossplay
configurationFields.description: When enabled, routes multiplayer traffic through Microsoft PlayFab instead of Steamworks (-crossplay), enabling cross-platform play between Steam, Xbox, and PC Game Pass players. Players can join by public IP and port, Join Code, or the server list; local or loopback IPs cannot be used. The Join Code is regenerated whenever the server restarts.

configurationFields.label: World Preset
configurationFields.description: Sets the world modifiers preset, which applies each modifier according to preconfigured levels. The preset can be overriden by custom modifier settings.

configurationFields.label: Admin Players
configurationFields.description: A list of player IDs that have in-game admin rights. Use the Platform User ID shown in the server log or the in-game F2 panel, formatted as [Platform]_[User ID] (case sensitive, e.g. Steam_76561198000000000). Plain Steam64 IDs are also accepted for Steam players. Saves directly to adminlist.txt.

configurationFields.label: Permitted Players
configurationFields.description: A whitelist of player IDs permitted to join this server. If this list is not empty, only players listed here can connect. Use the Platform User ID shown in the server log or the in-game F2 panel, formatted as [Platform]_[User ID] (case sensitive, e.g. Steam_76561198000000000). Plain Steam64 IDs are also accepted for Steam players. Saves directly to permittedlist.txt.

configurationFields.label: Banned Players
configurationFields.description: A list of player IDs that are banned from joining this server. Use the Platform User ID shown in the server log or the in-game F2 panel, formatted as [Platform]_[User ID] (case sensitive, e.g. Steam_76561198000000000). Plain Steam64 IDs are also accepted for Steam players. Saves directly to bannedlist.txt.

configurationFields.label: Combat Difficulty
configurationFields.description: Governs how much damage you give and take. Also governs how likely you are to encounter higher leveled enemies, and how dangerous they are.

configurationFields.label: Death Penalty Severity
configurationFields.description: Governs what happens when you die. From not dropping equipment and items, and heavily reduced skill loss, to permanent loss of equipment and skills.

configurationFields.label: Resource Drop Rate
configurationFields.description: Governs the amount of resources you gain from the world and from enemies.

configurationFields.label: Raid Event Frequency
configurationFields.description: Governs how often enemies may raid your base.

configurationFields.label: Portal Restriction Level
configurationFields.description: Changes how portals work in the game. From bringing all items through portal, to no portals at all.

configurationFields.label: No Build Cost
configurationFields.description: If set, build pieces require no materials to build. You still need to discover recipes as per usual.

configurationFields.label: Passive Enemies
configurationFields.description: If enabled, enemies won't attack until you provoke them.

configurationFields.label: Player Based Raids
configurationFields.description: If enabled, raids are based on the progress of each individual player, rather than on which bosses have been killed on the server. Recommended if you want the game to be slightly friendlier to players with different progress.

configurationFields.label: No Map
configurationFields.description: If set, you will not have access to the map or the minimap. This makes the game harder than intended, by requiring navigation by the stars and world tree.

configurationFields.label: Fire Hazards
configurationFields.description: If set, fire will spread realistically.

configurationFields.label: No Craft Cost
configurationFields.description: If set, crafting items requires no materials or crafting station. (-setkey nocraftcost)

configurationFields.label: All Pieces Unlocked
configurationFields.description: If set, all building pieces are unlocked immediately without needing to discover materials. (-setkey allpiecesunlocked)

configurationFields.label: No Workbench
configurationFields.description: If set, building pieces can be placed without a workbench or other crafting station in range. Crafting items still requires a station. (-setkey noworkbench)

configurationFields.label: No Building Collapse
configurationFields.description: If set, structural integrity is disabled: buildings and structures will not collapse or take damage from lack of support. (-setkey nobuildingfall)

configurationFields.label: Dungeon Building
configurationFields.description: If set, players can build and place structures inside dungeons, crypts, and caves. (-setkey dungeonbuild)

configurationFields.label: World Save Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the frequency of automatic world saves in seconds (-saveinterval). Default is 1800 seconds (30 minutes). Minimum is 5 seconds.

configurationFields.label: World Backup Retention Count
configurationFields.description: Sets how many automatic world backups are kept (-backups). The first uses the short-term interval and the rest use the long-term interval. Default is 4: one backup 2 hours old and three 12 hours apart.

configurationFields.label: Short-Term Backup Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval before the first automatic backup (-backupshort). Default is 7200 seconds (2 hours). Minimum is 5 seconds.

configurationFields.label: Long-Term Backup Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval between the subsequent automatic backups (-backuplong). Default is 43200 seconds (12 hours). Minimum is 5 seconds.

configurationFields.label: Server Instance ID
configurationFields.description: Unique identifier used to give this server its own PlayFab ID (-instanceid). Only relevant with Crossplay. If you host multiple servers with the same port from the same MAC address, set a different value for each. Leave blank otherwise.

configurationFields.label: Active Simulation Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the active world simulation radius around players (-simulationdistance). Valid range is 0 to 6. Leave blank to use the game default of 2 (Classic). Higher values keep more of the world simulated around each player, at a higher CPU cost.

configurationFields.label: Custom Command Line Options
configurationFields.description: WARNING: Advanced users only! Specifies additional raw command line parameters appended directly to the server launch command. All parameters MUST begin with a dash (e.g. -customflag). DO NOT duplicate arguments already managed by GSCS (-name, -port, -world, -password, -savedir, -public, -preset, etc.), as conflicting arguments can cause launch failures or crash the server.

configurationFields.label: GC Max Time Slice
configurationFields.description: Sets the time the incremental garbage collector may spend per frame (gc-max-time-slice in boot.config). Default is 3 milliseconds.

configurationFields.label: Grid Alignment Enable Hotkey

configurationFields.label: Grid Alignment Toggle Hotkey

configurationFields.label: Change Default Alignment Hotkey

configurationFields.label: Free Placement Rotation Enable

configurationFields.label: X Axis Rotation Placement Hotkey

configurationFields.label: Z Axis Rotation Placement Hotkey

configurationFields.label: Copy Placement Rotation Hotkey
configurationFields.description: Copy rotation of placement marker from target piece in front of you. Default F

configurationFields.label: Set Placement Perpendicular Hotkey

configurationFields.label: Hotkeys Settings Enable

configurationFields.label: Roll Forwards Hotkey
configurationFields.description: Roll forwards on hot key pressed. Default F9

configurationFields.label: Roll Backwards Hotkey
configurationFields.description: Roll backwards on hot key pressed. Default F10

configurationFields.label: Hud Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Show Required Items Enable
configurationFields.description: Shows the required amount of items AND the amount of items in your inventory in build mode and while crafting. This is enabled when the CraftFromChest section is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Show Experience Gained Notifications
configurationFields.description: Shows small notifications about all skill experience gained in the top left corner.

configurationFields.label: Remove Damage Red Flash
configurationFields.description: Removes the red screen flash overlay when the player takes damage.

configurationFields.label: Display Bow Ammo Counts
configurationFields.description: If bow is in hotbar, display current ammo & total ammo under hotbar icon

configurationFields.label: Map Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Enable Shared Map Progression
configurationFields.description: With this enabled you will receive the same exploration progression as other players on the server. This will also enable the option for the server to sync everyone's exploration progression on connecting to the server.

configurationFields.label: Map Exploration Radius
configurationFields.description: The radius of the map that you explore when moving.

configurationFields.label: Allow Disabling Map Sharing
configurationFields.description: Prevents you and other people on the server to turn off their map sharing option.

configurationFields.label: Show Carts and Boats on Map
configurationFields.description: Display carts and boats on the map.

configurationFields.label: Monster Projectile Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Monster Projectile Velocity
configurationFields.description: Value of 10 would increase the projectile velocity from 50 to 55.

configurationFields.label: Monster Projectile Accuracy
configurationFields.description: Value of (+)10 increase in accuracy will change the variance of projectile 1 degree to 0.9 degree at the point of projectile release.

configurationFields.label: Player Projectile Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Player Min Projectile Velocity
configurationFields.description: Value of 50 would increase the minimum charge velocity from 2 to 3.

configurationFields.label: Player Max Projectile Velocity
configurationFields.description: Value of 50 would increase the maximum charge velocity (of Finwood bow) from 50 to 75.

configurationFields.label: Player Min Projectile Accuracy
configurationFields.description: Value of (+)50 increase in accuracy will change the variance of arrows 20 degree to 10 degree at the point of minimum charge release.

configurationFields.label: Player Max Projectile Accuracy
configurationFields.description: Value of (+)50 increase in accuracy will change the variance of arrows 1 degree to 0.5 degree at the point of maximum charge release.

configurationFields.label: Enable Scale With Skill Level
configurationFields.description: Enabling this option will linearly scale by skill level from the base values of the weapon to the modified values (according to multipliers).

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Disable Structural Integrity
configurationFields.description: Disables the entire structural integrity system and allows for placement in free air, does not prevent building damage.

configurationFields.label: Allow Dismantling of Boats and Carts
configurationFields.description: Allow players to dismantle player-built boats and carts with a hammer instead of attacking and destroying them. Storage must be empty, and players cannot be interacting with the boat/cart before disassembly.

configurationFields.label: Disable Damage to Player Structures
configurationFields.description: Disables any damage from anything to all player built structures. Does not prevent damage from structural integrity.

configurationFields.label: Disable Damage to Player Boats
configurationFields.description: Disables any damage from anything to all player built boats.

configurationFields.label: Disable Water Force Damage to Player Boats
configurationFields.description: Disables water force damage to all player built boats.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Wood
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Stone
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Iron
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Hardwood
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Marble
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Ashstone
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Ancient
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Ice
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Structural Integrity Loss of Timberwood
configurationFields.description: Reduces the loss of structural integrity by distance in % less. The value 100 would result in disabled structural integrity over distance, does not allow for placement in free air without Disable Structural Integrity.

configurationFields.label: Disable Damage to Player Carts
configurationFields.description: Disables any damage from anything to all player built carts.

configurationFields.label: Disable Water Force Damage to Player Carts
configurationFields.description: Disables water force damage to all player built carts.

configurationFields.label: Ward Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Ward Range
configurationFields.description: The range of wards by meters. Default value 20

configurationFields.label: Ward Enemy Spawn Range
configurationFields.description: Set the enemy spawn radius around wards in meters. This value equals Ward Range if its set to 0.

configurationFields.label: Procreation Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Procreation Animal Types
configurationFields.description: A comma-separated list of animals that can breed. Valid types are: boar, hen, wolf, lox, asksvin, all, none.

configurationFields.label: Procreation Love Information
configurationFields.description: Enabling this displays the amount of love points an animal has.

configurationFields.label: Procreation Offspring Information
configurationFields.description: Enabling this displays the amount of time a newborn creature will take to grow.

configurationFields.label: Required Love Points Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier for the amount of successful checks required for a creature to become pregnant. 100 will double the amount of successful checks, -100 causes instant pregnancy.

configurationFields.label: Pregnancy Duration Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier for the duration of pregnancy. 100 will double the duration, -100 causes instant birth.

configurationFields.label: Pregnancy Chance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier for the chance of pregnancy. 100 will double the chance of a love point, -100 causes no love points.

configurationFields.label: Pregnancy Check Range Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier for the range of partner checks during pregnancy. 100 will double the range, -100 will make them unable to procreate.

configurationFields.label: Ignore Hunger
configurationFields.description: If enabled, animals will not require food to initiate breeding.

configurationFields.label: Ignore Alerted
configurationFields.description: If enabled, animals will breed even when alerted.

configurationFields.label: Creature Limit Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier to adjust limits of offspring that can be nearby before breeding halts. 100 will double the amount of offspring allowed, -100 will make them unable to breed.

configurationFields.label: Maturity Duration Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier to adjust the amount of time it takes for a creature to grow up after birth. 100 will double the duration, -100 will make them mature instantly.

configurationFields.label: Loot Drop Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Loot Drop Amount Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier to adjust the amount of loot dropped. A value of 100 will double drops, -100 will eliminate drops

configurationFields.label: Loot Drop Chance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier to adjust the chance of loot being dropped. A value of 100 will double the drop chance, -100 will eliminate drops

configurationFields.label: Wisp Spawner Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Maximum Wisps
configurationFields.description: This value determines the maximum amount of wisps per spawner.

configurationFields.label: Only Spawn at Night
configurationFields.description: Sets if wisps only spawn at night or also during the day.

configurationFields.label: Wisp Spawn Interval Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier to adjust the time between spawns. A value of -50 will result in a wisp trying to spawn every 2.5 seconds (5 seconds by default).

configurationFields.label: Wisp Spawn Chance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: A multiplier to adjust the chance of a wisp spawning. A value of 200 will result in a 100% wisp spawn chance.

configurationFields.label: Auto Stack Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Set to true to automatically perform the "Stack All" action on all chests in range. Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Auto Stack All Range
configurationFields.description: Defines the range to search chests for the "Stack All" action.

configurationFields.label: Auto Stack All Ignore Private Area Check
configurationFields.description: This option prevents to "Stack All" into chests from warded areas if the player does not have access to it. Turn it off to prevent stacking into warded areas you cannot access.

configurationFields.label: Auto Stack All Ignore Equipment
configurationFields.description: Set to true to prevent equipable items to be stored automatically.

configurationFields.label: Auto Stack Ignore Ammo
configurationFields.description: Set to true to prevent arrows and bolts to be stored automatically.

configurationFields.label: Auto Stack Ignore Food
configurationFields.description: Set to true to prevent food items to be stored automatically.

configurationFields.label: Auto Stack Ignore Mead
configurationFields.description: Set to true to prevent mead to be stored automatically.

configurationFields.label: Auto Stack Reply Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time in seconds the game will wait for a chest to respond to auto stack before skipping it.

configurationFields.label: Demister Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Wisp Light demister range
configurationFields.description: Sets the range of the wisp light demister field.

configurationFields.label: Wisp Torch demister range
configurationFields.description: Sets the range of the wisp torch demister field.

configurationFields.label: Mistwalker demister range
configurationFields.description: Sets the range of the mistwalker demister field.

configurationFields.label: Time Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Time Force Part Of Day
configurationFields.description: Enables forcing a specific time of day. This option disables other day duration settings.

configurationFields.label: Time Force Part Of Day Time
configurationFields.description: The part of day the time should be frozen to. 0 would be middle of night, 0.5 will be middle of day

configurationFields.label: Total Day Time In Seconds
configurationFields.description: Sets the duration of a whole day. This will affect the day count and may change time of day once after activation (new Worlds are not affected).

configurationFields.label: Time Night Percent
configurationFields.description: What percent of time is night. 0 is all daytime, 100 is all nighttime. Default is 30.

configurationFields.label: Ship Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Ship Forward Speed
configurationFields.description: This value determines the constant amount of force applied to the ship when sailing forward. A multiplier of 50 will result in the ship being 50% faster, -50 will result in the ship being 50% slower.

configurationFields.label: Ship Backward Speed
configurationFields.description: This value determines the amount of force applied to the ship when sailing backward. A multiplier of 50 will result in the ship moving backward 50% faster, -50 will result in the opposite.

configurationFields.label: Ship Rudder Speed
configurationFields.description: This value determines the speed of turning the wheel of the ship. A multiplier of 50 will result in the wheel turning 50% faster, -50 will result in the opposite.

configurationFields.label: Ship Steer Force
configurationFields.description: This value determines the force applied to the ship when steering. A multiplier of 50 will result in the ship turning 50% faster, -50 will result in the opposite.

configurationFields.label: Ship Water Impact Damage
configurationFields.description: This value determines the amount of damage the ship takes while sailing. A multiplier of 50 will result in the ship taking 50% more damage, -50 will result in the opposite.

configurationFields.label: Egg Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Egg Show Hatch Time
configurationFields.description: If set to true the time until the egg hatches will be displayed on hover.

configurationFields.label: Egg Hatch Time
configurationFields.description: This value determines the time it takes for an egg to initially hatch into a chicken in seconds. A value of 300 means 5 minutes.

configurationFields.label: Chick Grow Time
configurationFields.description: This value determines the time it takes for a chicken to grow into an adult in seconds. A value of 3000 means 50 minutes.

configurationFields.label: Egg Require Shelter
configurationFields.description: This value determines whether or not an egg requires a roof and fire to grow. If set to false, eggs will grow anywhere.

configurationFields.label: Egg Can Stack
configurationFields.description: This value determines whether or not eggs can grow in a stack on the ground. If set to true eggs will grow as many chickens as there are eggs in the dropped stack.

configurationFields.label: Egg Sold By Default
configurationFields.description: If set to true eggs are sold by Haldor without any requirements.

configurationFields.label: Egg Sell Price
configurationFields.description: This value determines the cost of an egg sold by Haldor

configurationFields.label: Frigid Kiln Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Frigid Kiln Frozen Fuel Production Speed
configurationFields.description: This value determines the time in seconds to produce a single frozen fuel. Default: 30

configurationFields.label: Frigid Kiln Maximum Ice
configurationFields.description: This sets the maximum amount of ice that the frigid kiln can hold at once. Default: 25

configurationFields.label: Frigid Kiln Ice Consumed Per Frozen Fuel
configurationFields.description: This sets the amount of ice consumed to produce a single frozen fuel. Default: 5

configurationFields.label: Frigid Kiln Auto Deposit
configurationFields.description: Instead of dropping the items, they will be placed inside the nearest nearby chests.

configurationFields.label: Frigid Kiln Auto Fuel
configurationFields.description: When enabled, the frigid kiln will automatically pull ice from nearby chests.

configurationFields.label: Frigid Kiln Ignore Private Area Check
configurationFields.description: This option prevents the frigid kiln from pulling items from warded areas if it isn't placed inside of it. For convenience, we recommend this be enabled

configurationFields.label: Frigid Kiln Auto Deposit/Fuel Range
configurationFields.description: The range of the chest detection for the auto deposit and auto fuel features. Maximum is 50

configurationFields.label: Frost Foundry Settings Enable
configurationFields.description: Enabling this section gives you access to the settings up to the next section.

configurationFields.label: Frost Foundry Frozen Fuel Production Speed
configurationFields.description: This value determines the time in seconds to produce a single item. Default: 50

configurationFields.label: Frost Foundry Maximum Frozen Fuel
configurationFields.description: This sets the maximum amount of frozen fuel that the Frost Foundry can hold at once. Default: 20

configurationFields.label: Frost Foundry Ice Consumed Per Frozen Fuel
configurationFields.description: This sets the amount of ice consumed to produce a single frozen fuel. Default: 5

configurationFields.label: Frost Foundry Auto Fuel
configurationFields.description: When enabled, the frost foundry will automatically pull frozen fuel from nearby chests.

configurationFields.label: Frost Foundry Ignore Private Area Check
configurationFields.description: This option prevents the frost foundry from pulling items from warded areas if it isn't placed inside of it. For convenience, we recommend this be enabled

configurationFields.label: Frost Foundry Auto Deposit Range
configurationFields.description: The range of the chest detection for the auto fuel feature. Maximum is 50
